name: Grok Bot Notify
description: Hands what needs a person in Orca projects (terminals and chats blocked or asking, FullOps decisions, ask judgments, holds, failures, escalations) to an Orca bot as local mail, and Orca bots' Needs you items to Grok Bot. The alert half of orca-helm.

settings.title: Orca bots (one per line)
settings.description: Who gets project alerts that need a person, as local mail (orca orchestration send --to bot:<name> --type question; no login, no webhook): terminals and chats that are blocked or end on a question, FullOps decisions, ask or blocked judgments, holds, failures and escalations. One line per bot: name | workspaces, workspaces as in Routes (empty is every workspace). Left empty, the one bot `orca bot list` shows gets them, and none when there are several. off sends none. A bot's own chat never goes to it.

settings.title: Routes (one Grok Bot per line)
settings.description: Edited from the Grok Bot panel in the right sidebar (one card per bot, workspaces as checkboxes). Grok Bot gets Orca bots' Needs you items (name the bot among a line's workspaces), and project alerts only with the setting below. It stores one line per bot: name | workspaces | routine URL | Authorization; typing lines here still works. On save the Authorization value moves to encrypted secrets and the line ends in (saved).

settings.title: Grok Bot routine URL
settings.description: Only while Routes has no valid line: one routine URL that gets every workspace's alerts.

settings.title: Authorization value
settings.description: Only while Routes has no valid line: the Authorization value for the URL above. Paste it once; the worker moves it into encrypted secrets and clears this field (when secrets are unavailable, it stays here and is sent as is).

settings.title: Also send project alerts to Grok Bot
settings.description: Off (the default): Grok Bot routes get only Orca bots' Needs you items, and an Orca bot gets project alerts. On: agent states, FullOps events and Claude Code question cards also go to the routes, as up to 0.6.0. For 0.6.0's behavior exactly, also set Orca bots to off.

settings.title: States
settings.description: With project alerts to Grok Bot on: comma-separated agent states to hand to it: done, waiting, blocked, working.

settings.title: Reminder minutes
settings.description: A terminal's alert is sent only when its last output changes (or, when the output cannot be read, its state). Set minutes to send the same state and output once more as a reminder after they last that long; 0 (the default) never reminds, so a missed question is not asked again.

settings.title: Send FullOps auto judgments
settings.description: Also hand a bot-started task's FullOps auto judgment to the Orca bot (and Grok Bot when it gets project alerts). Decisions, ask judgments, holds, failures and escalations always go.
